reuse.why: The flag is taken by the existing shared categoriesForMonthBudgetAction selection, which every converted action already calls.

duplication.why: The rule change itself is in one place; only the parameter plumbing is repeated per action, on top of the pre-existing duplicated category queries the diff leaves alone.

placement.why: The hidden-category variation lives in the shared month-budget selection module, where the other exclusions already are.

scope.why: Touches only the month-wide actions, the selection helper and its test.

maintainability.why: Clean explicit parameter, but copyPreviousMonth, also a month-wide action using the same helper, was not given the flag, leaving an inconsistency a maintainer must notice.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All changed actions route the flag through categoriesForMonthBudgetAction.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic introduced; the rule is a single new branch in the shared helper.
